label: Flowchart
intent: Show a process, decision, or directed relationship among steps.
avoid: Avoid when order or relationships are not central or a short list is clearer.
compatibility: Unknown; check destination Mermaid version and feature support.

label: Sequence Diagram
intent: Show interactions between participants over time.
avoid: Avoid for static structure or when there are too many messages to scan.
compatibility: Unknown; check destination Mermaid version and feature support.

label: Class Diagram
intent: Show classes or entities, members, and their relationships.
avoid: Avoid when implementation-level structure is not the point.
compatibility: Unknown; check destination Mermaid version and feature support.

label: State Diagram
intent: Show states and transitions in a system or process.
avoid: Avoid when there are no meaningful states or transitions.
compatibility: Unknown; check destination Mermaid version and feature support.

label: Entity Relationship Diagram
intent: Show data entities and their relationships or cardinality.
avoid: Avoid when the data model is not central or a compact table suffices.
compatibility: Unknown; check destination Mermaid version and feature support.

label: User Journey
intent: Summarize steps, tasks, and satisfaction across a user experience.
avoid: Avoid for backend process flow without a user perspective.
compatibility: Unknown; check destination Mermaid version and feature support.

label: Gantt Chart
intent: Show tasks, durations, dependencies, and schedule on a timeline.
avoid: Avoid when precise scheduling is not needed or many dates obscure the message.
compatibility: Unknown; check destination Mermaid version and feature support.

label: Pie Chart
intent: Show parts of a whole as proportions.
avoid: Avoid for close values, many slices, or non-partition data; use a table/bar chart instead.
compatibility: Unknown; check destination Mermaid version and feature support.

label: Quadrant Chart
intent: Compare items on two labeled dimensions.
avoid: Avoid when dimensions are not meaningful or precise numeric comparison is required.
compatibility: Unknown; check destination Mermaid version and feature support.

label: Requirement Diagram
intent: Show requirements, verification elements, and trace relationships.
avoid: Avoid when requirements traceability is not the subject.
compatibility: Unknown; check destination Mermaid version and feature support.

label: Git Graph
intent: Show branches, commits, merges, or releases in a repository history.
avoid: Avoid for general process flow or histories with too many commits to read.
compatibility: Unknown; check destination Mermaid version and feature support.

label: C4 Diagram
intent: Show software architecture at a C4 abstraction level and its relationships.
avoid: Avoid mixing abstraction levels or implying automatically complete layout.
compatibility: Five variants documented; partial PlantUML-style manual layout; verify target rendering.

label: Mindmap
intent: Show a central topic with branching related ideas.
avoid: Avoid when precise directional relationships or hierarchy semantics matter; avoid experimental icons by default.
compatibility: Icons are experimental; avoid by default. Other version support unknown; verify target.

label: Timeline
intent: Show dated or ordered events over time.
avoid: Avoid when causal or dependency relationships need a different diagram.
compatibility: Unknown; check destination Mermaid version and feature support.

label: ZenUML
intent: Show interactions in a compact sequence-oriented notation.
avoid: Avoid unless the external ZenUML plugin is available and target rendering is checked.
compatibility: External plugin required; unsupported by bundled unmodified validator. Target capability must be verified.

label: Sankey Diagram
intent: Show quantities flowing between stages or categories.
avoid: Avoid when flow magnitude is unavailable or the diagram would have many unreadable links.
compatibility: Unknown; check destination Mermaid version and feature support.

label: XY Chart
intent: Plot values against X and Y axes for a compact chart.
avoid: Avoid when values need detailed statistical treatment or a richer chart is clearer.
compatibility: Unknown; check destination Mermaid version and feature support.

label: Block Diagram
intent: Show components as blocks and their connections or placement.
avoid: Avoid when a sequence, data model, or formal architecture view is more precise.
compatibility: Unknown; check destination Mermaid version and feature support.

label: Packet Diagram
intent: Show packet fields and their relative layout.
avoid: Avoid for general data structures or diagrams without packet-format meaning.
compatibility: Documented for Mermaid 11+; family minimum, not parser-support evidence.

label: Kanban Board
intent: Show work items grouped by status or workflow column.
avoid: Avoid when a compact task list or actual interactive board is needed.
compatibility: Unknown; check destination Mermaid version and feature support.

label: Event Modeling
intent: Show events, commands, views, and system behavior over time.
avoid: Avoid when the model's specialized event-oriented notation is unfamiliar to the audience.
compatibility: Documented for Mermaid 11.15+; family minimum, not parser-support evidence.

label: Treemap
intent: Show hierarchical values as nested areas.
avoid: Avoid when values are incomparable, hierarchy is unclear, or exact comparisons matter.
compatibility: Non-beta in pinned official registry; optional legacy -beta alias does not change status.

label: Ishikawa Diagram
intent: Organize possible causes around an effect for a cause-analysis discussion.
avoid: Avoid treating candidate causes as proven or using it instead of evidence-based diagnosis.
compatibility: Documented for Mermaid 11.12.3+; non-beta in pinned registry despite optional -beta alias.
